name: Advanced Sidebar Nav
author: Nazmul Sabuz

sections.description:
Advanced Sidebar Nav is a powerful WordPress widget that provides an elegant and customizable way to display navigation menus in your sidebar. Perfect for showcasing hierarchical menu structures with unlimited depth levels.

Key Features:
* Display any WordPress menu in your sidebar with unlimited depth levels
* Clean HTML output for better SEO and accessibility
* Customizable styling options to match your theme
* Lightweight and performance-optimized
* Compatible with all modern WordPress themes
* Easy to use widget interface

Whether you need a simple navigation menu or a complex multi-level site structure, Advanced Sidebar Nav handles it all with ease. The widget automatically adapts to your menu structure and provides a clean, professional appearance that enhances your site’s navigation experience.
sections.installation:
After downloading and extracting the latest version of the plugin:

  1. Install using the WordPress Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Widgets.
  4. Drag Advanced Sidebar Nav into the widget area.
  5. Enjoy!

If you encounter any bugs, or have comments or suggestions, please submit a ticket using support forum.
